main_text.l: quidlibet contra serenif. noftrum regem aggredi,
aut vindictam contra adversarios noftros in Anglia
exercere, (quos in ampliffimis Angliæ comitiis ju-
dicari petimus) aut occupatis Anglorum bonis nos-
met locupletare, ullam denique omnino Angliæ in-
juriam inferre: quin contra operam omnem & fa-
cultates noftras in ipforum Anglorum commodum
lubenter profundemus, prout gratitudinis leges po-
stulant, ob auxilia olim nobis præstita in ipsis pri-
mæ noftræ reformationis exordiis, quibus à tyran-
nide factionis Gallico-Guisianæ liberatos nos fuisse
grata mente recolimus: firmum manebit hoc æterni
in Anglos amoris & pacis vinculum, Conscientia
noftra, & Deus conscientiis noftris major nobis te-
stantur, solam nobis propositam esse Dei gloriam,
utriusque gentis firmam pacem, & genuinum sere-
nissimi regis noftri honorem; & ut legitime ac ordine
in Israelis turbatores animadvertatur, incendiarios
istos intelligimus ab inferis excitatos, Corahos, Ba-
laamos, Doegos, Rhabshakeos, Hamanos, Tobiahos, Sanbal-
latos hodiernos; quo peracto nobis abunde satisfiet.
Neque militarem hanc expeditionem in Angliam
ut medium ad sanctos illos fines obtinendos prius
aggressi sumus, quam alia omnia irrita hostium va-
fritie reddita nobis effent: ita quidem ut hoc ulti-
mum & unicum remedium nobis nunc superfit.
6. Si Domino visum fuerit expeditioni huic be-
nedicere, & peccata noftra ac Anglorum oppositio
non obstent, quam dulces fructus utraque gens si-
mul cum posteris carpet, ac quanto futuri sunt sola-
tio exteris reformatis ecclesiis suaves eventus? Nam
reformatio Scotiæ ad primævam suam formam re-
vocabitur, Angliæ vero reformatio, tot piorum pre-
cibus frequentissimè expetita, perfectionem suam
tandem assequetur; tum in doctrinæ ac cultus, tum

page.notes: Running head and year read as printed: "IN REGNO SCOTIÆ." and "1640." Page number 541 at upper right. The word "serenif." is printed with a long-s form and an abbreviation point; transcribed as "serenif." Doubtful: "Guisianæ" (printed as "Guifiane" in the scan, read here as Guisianæ with italic type); "Rhabshakeos" printed as "Rhabshakeos". The mark ᴗ and small strokes at the lower margin are a printer's mark or show-through and are not transcribed. No signature visible.
